title: "Maaslin2 BMI adjusted"
format: html

```{r}
# ============================================================
#MaAsLin2 RefSeq genus-level association models
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Maaslin2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
})

# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------

data_dir <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Data"

metadata_file_tsv <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

viral_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_viral_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

out_root <- file.path(data_dir, "maaslin2_refseq_results_adjusted")
dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# Load matrix and match metadata
# -----------------------------

load_and_match <- function(matrix_file, metadata_file_tsv) {
  
  # Matrix format: rows = samples, columns = taxa
  mat <- read.delim(
    matrix_file,
    sep = "\t",
    header = TRUE,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # Remove trailing _1 from matrix sample IDs
  matrix_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(mat))
  rownames(mat) <- matrix_ids_clean
  
  # Read metadata safely
  meta <- read.delim(
    metadata_file_tsv,
    sep = "\t",
    header = TRUE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # First column contains ID_1, ID_2, etc.
  colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"
  
  # Check unmatched samples
  unmatched <- setdiff(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)
  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    stop("Unmatched samples found: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # Match metadata to matrix order using reads_ID
  meta <- meta[match(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID), ]
  
  # Confirm metadata order
  if (!all(meta$reads_ID == matrix_ids_clean)) {
    stop("Metadata order mismatch")
  }
  
  rownames(meta) <- meta$reads_ID
  
  return(list(mat = mat, meta = meta))
}

# -----------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# -----------------------------

prepare_metadata <- function(meta) {
  
  meta$outcome <- factor(meta$outcome, levels = c("TERM", "sPTB"))
  meta$sPTB34 <- factor(meta$sPTB34, levels = c("no", "yes"))
  
  # Important: metadata column is lowercase bmi
  meta$bmi <- as.numeric(meta$bmi)
  
  return(meta)
}

# -----------------------------
# Run MaAsLin2 model
# -----------------------------

run_maaslin_model <- function(mat, meta, dataset_name, outcome_var, adjust_bmi = FALSE) {
  
  fixed_effects <- outcome_var
  
  if (adjust_bmi) {
    fixed_effects <- c(outcome_var, "bmi")
  }
  
  # Keep only samples complete for variables in this model
  keep <- complete.cases(meta[, fixed_effects, drop = FALSE])
  
  mat_model <- as.data.frame(mat[keep, , drop = FALSE])
  meta_model <- as.data.frame(meta[keep, fixed_effects, drop = FALSE])
  
  # Explicit rownames required by MaAsLin2
  sample_ids <- rownames(mat)[keep]
  rownames(mat_model) <- sample_ids
  rownames(meta_model) <- sample_ids
  
  # Safety checks
  if (any(is.na(rownames(mat_model))) || any(rownames(mat_model) == "")) {
    stop("Missing matrix sample IDs")
  }
  
  if (any(duplicated(rownames(mat_model)))) {
    stop("Duplicate matrix sample IDs")
  }
  
  if (!all(rownames(mat_model) == rownames(meta_model))) {
    stop("Matrix and metadata sample IDs do not match before MaAsLin2")
  }
  
  model_name <- paste0(
    dataset_name, "_",
    outcome_var, "_",
    ifelse(adjust_bmi, "BMI_adjusted", "unadjusted")
  )
  
  out_dir <- file.path(out_root, model_name)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  message("Running: ", model_name)
  message("Samples: ", nrow(mat_model))
  message("Taxa: ", ncol(mat_model))
  message("Sample IDs match: ", all(rownames(mat_model) == rownames(meta_model)))
  
  Maaslin2(
    input_data = mat_model,
    input_metadata = meta_model,
    output = out_dir,
    fixed_effects = fixed_effects,
    normalization = "TSS",
    transform = "LOG",
    analysis_method = "LM",
    correction = "BH",
    max_significance = 0.05,
    standardize = FALSE,
    plot_heatmap = FALSE,
    plot_scatter = FALSE
  )
  
  message("Finished: ", model_name)
}

# -----------------------------
# Load and prepare datasets
# -----------------------------

fungi <- load_and_match(fungal_file, metadata_file_tsv)
viruses <- load_and_match(viral_file, metadata_file_tsv)

fungi$meta <- prepare_metadata(fungi$meta)
viruses$meta <- prepare_metadata(viruses$meta)

# -----------------------------
# RefSeq fungi: priority models
# -----------------------------

run_maaslin_model(fungi$mat, fungi$meta, "refseq_fungal_genus", "outcome", FALSE)
run_maaslin_model(fungi$mat, fungi$meta, "refseq_fungal_genus", "outcome", TRUE)

run_maaslin_model(fungi$mat, fungi$meta, "refseq_fungal_genus", "sPTB34", FALSE)
run_maaslin_model(fungi$mat, fungi$meta, "refseq_fungal_genus", "sPTB34", TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# RefSeq viruses: secondary models
# -----------------------------

run_maaslin_model(viruses$mat, viruses$meta, "refseq_viral_genus", "outcome", FALSE)
run_maaslin_model(viruses$mat, viruses$meta, "refseq_viral_genus", "outcome", TRUE)

run_maaslin_model(viruses$mat, viruses$meta, "refseq_viral_genus", "sPTB34", FALSE)
run_maaslin_model(viruses$mat, viruses$meta, "refseq_viral_genus", "sPTB34", TRUE)

message("All Step 14A MaAsLin2 models completed.")
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Combine all nominally significant MaAsLin2 results
# (raw p < 0.05)
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

maaslin_files <- list.files(
  out_root,
  pattern = "all_results.tsv",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

all_results <- lapply(maaslin_files, function(file) {
  
  model_name <- basename(dirname(file))
  
  read_tsv(
    file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(model = model_name)
  
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Keep only nominally significant results
nominal_hits <- all_results %>%
  filter(pval < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(pval) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      qval < 0.05 ~ "FDR significant",
      TRUE ~ "Nominal only"
    )
  )

# Save CSV
write_csv(
  nominal_hits,
  file.path(
    out_root,
    "all_nominal_p005_results.csv"
  )
)

message(
  "Saved ",
  nrow(nominal_hits),
  " nominally significant results."
)
```
